summary: Iteration 5 — Projects + PDF end-to-end testing. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass (Projects CRUD auth+isolation, attach/detach with cross-user 404, DELETE project detaches walls, WallCreate accepts project_id, GET /walls?project_id filter, wall PDF + project PDF valid %PDF- bytes with attachment Content-Disposition and application/pdf media type, 401 unauth and 404 for foreign owner on both PDF endpoints). Frontend: admin login → home shows btn-projetos with 'N CADASTRADOS' and btn-paredes-salvas counts; /projetos renders projects-grid; btn-toggle-new-project reveals new-project-form; input-project-nome/cliente/telefone/endereco + btn-save-project creates project and navigates to /projeto/{id}; project-meta-card shows cliente info; btn-download-project-pdf link points to /api/projects/{id}/pdf; btn-whatsapp-project, btn-new-wall-in-project, btn-attach-existing all present; attach-modal opens and lists unlinked walls (9 candidates for admin); btn-new-wall-in-project passes defaultProjectId via location.state and /parede/nova has select-project pre-selected (verified after async projects list loaded); btn-salvar-tudo then navigates back to /projeto/{id}; /paredes list has both btn-export-{id} and btn-pdf-{id} per wall card with correct /api/walls/{id}/pdf href.

issues: Minor race: on mount, projects list is fetched async via useEffect. Before it resolves, <select> has no matching <option> so it briefly renders the placeholder ('— sem projeto —') even though wall.project_id state is set. Once projects load (~200ms), the correct option becomes selected. Not visible to end-users in practice but could be pre-populated by seeding a single-option list with {id: defaultProjectId, nome: 'carregando...'} or by disabling the select until projects load.

critical_code_review_comments: projects.py update_project uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) on ProjectCreate — but ProjectCreate declares all fields with Optional defaults, so PUT with a partial body still zeroes out missing fields when the client omits keys. Currently the UI sends the full meta object so it works, but a partial PATCH-style update from another client would clobber fields. Consider a ProjectUpdate model with truly optional semantics or switch to $set-only-provided keys explicitly.

server.py list_walls filter accepts project_id but doesn't validate the caller owns that project. That's fine because the query already scopes to user_id so cross-user leakage is impossible, but returning [] silently for a foreign project id could be confusing. Optional: 404 when project_id is unknown/foreign.

pdf_report.py builds PDFs synchronously in the request thread (reportlab is CPU-bound). For a project with many walls this can block the FastAPI event loop. Wrap build_wall_pdf/build_project_pdf in `await asyncio.to_thread(...)` before returning.

ProjetoDetalhe.jsx uses `data-testid="btn-export-wall-${id}"` (not `btn-export-${id}`) — inconsistent with ParedesSalvas.jsx (`btn-export-${id}`). Not a blocker; the request only mandates btn-export-{id}/btn-pdf-{id} on ParedesSalvas, which is compliant. But consistency would be nice.

CriarParede.jsx: after createWall failure with 402, error toast is shown but wall.project_id is still set; retry after upgrade works. OK. Also note: on the /parede/nova page, the select-project has an async race — see design_issues above.
